description.value: White Sails is an award-winning craft brewery and taproom that has been a fixture of downtown Nanaimo since 2015, located across from Maffeo Sutton Park. The large, open-concept west-coast-inspired space seats over 100 guests and offers up to 14 beers on tap alongside wines, ciders, a full coffee bar, and a hyper-local food menu sourced from neighbourhood butchers, bakers, and cheese-makers. Its medal-winning flagship beers and rotating small-batch releases make it a genuine destination stop on any Vancouver Island cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates the OSM address (125 Comox Rd), phone (250.754.2337), and email.
